hero.headline:
Bridging Enterprise SaaS Implementation and
AI-Driven Automation
hero.description: Enterprise SaaS implementation professional with 10+ years of experience spanning customer-facing delivery, business process analysis and operational data. Leads complex implementations from discovery and process mapping through solution design, platform configuration, data transformation, integrations, UAT and go-live. Combines hands-on SQL, Excel and API integration experience with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable platform solutions. Also builds AI-enabled workflows and knowledge systems that improve implementation delivery and team productivity.

experience.title: AI Implementation Manager
bullets: Own enterprise customer implementations on Rocketlane’s Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform, leading discovery, process mapping, solution design, configuration, integrations, data migration and go-live.

Prepare complex customer data for platform onboarding by mapping source fields to Rocketlane’s data model, cleansing and validating records, resolving duplicates, and transforming multi-year project data from spreadsheets and other systems.

Lead solution design and implementation for enterprise integrations, coordinating data flows and requirements across customer systems and Rocketlane; currently serving as solution architect and implementation manager for Phase 2 of NICE.
Implement Nitro, Rocketlane’s agentic AI platform, by translating customer use cases into purpose-built agents and workflow automations.
Built internal AI agents as part of the Customer Zero team to support implementation handovers, kickoff preparation, workshops, solution design and UAT.
Built Atlas, an AI-powered implementation knowledge system that captures previously solved customer use cases and makes approved solutions searchable across the Professional Services team.

highlights.label: Nitro · Implementation agents
highlights.text:
Use cases: Sales-to-implementation handovers, kickoff decks, workshop preparation and recaps, solution design documents, UAT scripts and form-to-Sheets reporting.
Approach: Uses project context—including documents, meetings and transcripts—already available in Rocketlane to reduce manual context gathering.
Estimated impact: 20–30% less time per deliverable, with more consistent outputs.

highlights.label: Nitro · Configuration agent (POC)
highlights.text:
Problem: Platform settings, notifications and automations were configured manually after design approval.
Solution: Designed a Nitro Workforce agent to interpret solution design documents and identify required configuration.
Automation: Used Browserbase to navigate Rocketlane and configure settings and automations; the product team subsequently validated the proof of concept.

highlights.label: Atlas · AI implementation knowledge system
highlights.text:
Problem: Implementation knowledge was fragmented across team members, call transcripts and documents, leading to repeated problem-solving.
Solution: Built an AI-assisted workflow to extract use cases and solutions from Avoma transcripts and Freshdesk tickets, with Implementation Manager review before publishing. A Lovable backend agent uses Supermemory to retrieve approved solutions and validate them against current product and API documentation.
Impact: 60–65% team adoption, approximately 10 queries per user per week and 70–80% reported usefulness.

highlights.label: Implementation data work
highlights.text: Selected implementation data work includes source-to-target mapping, cleansing, validation and transformation of thousands of records, including multi-year project histories migrated from spreadsheets and other systems.

experience.title: Lead, Product Implementation
bullets: Led enterprise CMMS implementations across the UK, Ireland, US, Middle East and Australia, delivering engagements representing $6M in total contract value and nearly $1M in implementation and expansion value.
Directed complex implementations typically spanning 6–12 months, multiple business units and hundreds to thousands of employees.

Facilitated executive and operational discovery workshops, mapped business processes, documented requirements in BRDs and solution designs, developed WBS-based implementation plans, and led configuration, testing, UAT and go-live.
Mapped customer source data to platform structures and managed large-scale data preparation, cleansing, transformation, validation and migration using Excel and customer-system exports.

Worked on financial and invoice-related implementations, understanding customer billing structures and configuring the exchange of financial data with external systems. Supported revenue-recognition requirements, including a customer-specific application to track recognition based on task completion rather than hours or milestone completion.

highlights.label: Global enterprise delivery
highlights.text: Delivered on-site engagements in Saudi Arabia for a half-million-dollar project and in the UK for MHA, covering requirements gathering, stakeholder workshops and go-live training.

highlights.label: Pilot-to-enterprise expansion
highlights.text: Converted customer pilots into full-scale enterprise rollouts through structured discovery and early value demonstration, contributing more than $350K in expansion value.

highlights.label: Implementation framework
highlights.text: Built a use-case-driven implementation framework with complexity scoring and effort models. Helped pre-sales scope work more accurately, estimate timelines and reduce ambiguity in BRDs and UAT.

highlights.label: Revenue impact & scope governance
highlights.text: Identified unbilled scope changes and introduced a structured, manual estimation and tracking process with Sales. Distinguished short-duration changes from scope creep requiring formal change management, and introduced pre-purchased Professional Services credits. The process was implemented for one customer.

highlights.label: AI configuration assistant
highlights.text: Developed a retrieval-augmented AI assistant over XML platform configurations, enabling support teams to answer configuration questions in natural language and reducing their reliance on implementation engineers after go-live. The support team had previously required approximately 2–6 hours of engineering assistance per week.

experience.title: Senior Catalog Specialist
bullets: Designed a data-driven defect prioritisation framework using product forecasts, inventory value and glance-view signals. Built SQL-driven queries and a ranking algorithm to focus teams on high-impact tickets, delivering an estimated $230K in monthly savings.

Independently queried operational data using SQL and analysed catalog and procurement defects in Excel to identify recurring patterns and SOP gaps, reducing invalid case assignments between support teams by approximately 50 per day.
Resolved catalog and procurement defects across Amazon Fresh, Amazon Pantry and Prime Now, improving operational efficiency.

projects.name: Atlas
projects.description: Turns customer calls, tickets, Slack, and project docs into human-approved implementation solutions. Answers are checked against current product knowledge so retired features don’t resurface, and answers marked wrong are classified by a validator agent and routed to an admin review queue.

projects.name: AI Config Assistant
projects.description: AI-powered assistant that lets support teams query enterprise platform configurations in natural language — eliminating dependency on implementation engineers post go-live.

projects.name: FAAX
projects.description: Bridges the gap between raw trading interfaces and disciplined strategy-driven execution. Users define structured trading blueprints — AI monitors conditions, generates setups, and drafts trades for human approval.

projects.name: Resume Studio
projects.description: AI studio behind this site. Paste a job description or a link and it tailors the resume to the role, checks every line against a record of my verified career facts so nothing is invented, and lets me review and edit before publishing a company-specific page and PDF. An ATS-style scorer, powered by Jev (TypeSafe AI's classifier model), judges how well the resume covers each requirement, and can be compared side by side with Claude.
